notes: Tennessee's enactment of the Uniform Residential Landlord and Tenant Act: security deposits, habitability, rent, notice and eviction. A scope point a human should check: the Tennessee URLTA has historically applied only in counties above a population threshold, with general leases (Title 66, Chapter 7) governing elsewhere, so the geographic scope provision matters for encoding.
